name: Cultural Landscape of the Serra de Tramuntana
description: The Serra de Tramuntana is a steep mountain range running along Mallorca's northwest coast, where cliffs drop sharply to the Mediterranean. Over many centuries, farmers shaped its slopes into stepped stone terraces and built an intricate system of channels, water mills and dry stone walls to cope with scarce water. Old estates and farmhouses still dot the hillsides, making it a living record of island farming.
